important_evidence: AmpGram outperforms top-ranking AMP classifiers, including AMPScanner, CAMPR3R and iAMPpred. It is the first AMP prediction tool created for longer AMPs and for high-throughput proteomic screening.
AMPScanner V2 was the first tool to apply a deep learning model for AMP prediction.
ampir achieves high performance using machine learning approaches and is devised for proteome-wide analyses.
Macrel is optimized for genome and metagenome screenings, allowing the input of DNA sequences.
uncertainties: Exact URL for AmpGram web server and R package is not provided in the extracted evidence; full URL retrieval from the original paper or supplementary material is needed.
The review mentions many tools without performance details; full-text verification of the original papers is required to confirm their benchmark suitability.

The peptidomics and proteomics papers (doi:10.1021/acsomega.6c00679, doi:10.3390/biom15081121) do not introduce new AMP prediction models and were omitted from the model list, but they may contain useful datasets or benchmark results if examined more closely.
